BidProject.Title: Nevada State University @ NLV Gateway
BidProject.ProjectDescription:
Project Description:

This is a competitively bid project for a 11.06 acre site development and a 46,200 SF tenant improvement for a building in North Las Vegas, Nevada.

Project Address: 800 & 820 E Lake Mead Blvd, North Las Vegas, 89030

 

ALL PROPOSALS MUST BE SUBMITTED TO: estimating@buildwithdcbg.com TO BE CONSIDERED. 

 

Scope of Work:

The project consists of but is not limited to final clean, dumpsters, concrete, masonry, structural metals, ornamental metals, rough wood framing, millwork, roofing, insulation, fireproofing, misc. caulking, doors and frames, glazing, metal stud framing and drywall, acoustical ceilings, painting, stucco, tile, flooring, concrete flooring, toilet partitions & accessories, specialties, signage, fire extinguishers, fire sprinklers, plumbing, HVAC, electrical, low-voltage, fire alarm, earthwork, exterior improvements, landscaping, striping and utilities.

 

Instruction to Bidders:

  •      Submit all RFI’s in writing to estimating@buildwithdcbg.com.
  •      All bids are due September 30th, 2026 by 5pm.
  •      Please acknowledge all bid documents, RFIs, addenda, etc. on your proposal.
  •      VE (Value Engineering) suggestions. Please bid per plans and give any VE pricing as deductive alternates. 
  •      Please provide long lead times on proposal.
  •      Refer to sheet AC.2 on TI Drawings for Responsibility Schedule.
  •      PLEASE NOTE THIS PROJECT IS NOT PREVAILING WAGE.
  •      Please utilize Owner Bid Form. 

Smart Bid: DC Building Group is using Smart Bid for our ITB’s.   If you have any issues accessing bid documents, please contact Smart Bid directly.   If Additional contacts need to be added, please contact Nicole Burguin nicoleb@buildwithdcbg.com 

Site Visit:

All bidders are required to visit the site to familiarize themselves with existing conditions.  Should a formal job walk be scheduled, all bidders will be notified.

 

General Information & Instructions:

Verify your license limit and insurance requirements in the DCBG Sub Contract General Conditions document prior to bidding.

Procore, construction management software must be used by all subcontractors & suppliers on all active DCBG projects.
